title: Aircraft Mass Properties Calculator — Overview and definition
t: Aircraft Mass Properties Calculator — Overview and definition
description: Computes weight, center of gravity, and inertia from the parts breakdown.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Computes weight, center of gravity, and inertia from the parts breakdown. A mass properties calculator rolls up part weights and positions into total weight, CG, and inertia tensor, tracking growth allowances and weighing-test correlation. Real implementations include custom spreadsheets/databases and modules in AAA/RDS. It flags CG excursions outside the allowable envelope. Engineering use only. Capability specification and design target: this database describes what the tool must do, not a claim of implementation or deployment. Defensive and engineering content only — no weapon-targeting or attack-execution content.
capabilities: Bottom-up weight roll-up with growth allowances
CG and inertia tensor computation per loading case
Weighing-test correlation and adjustment
CG envelope checking across fuel/payload cases
Weight-reduction trade tracking
